Returns the confirmed release date (November 19, 2026, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S), the full days left, and the exact unlock moments for New Zealand, the United Kingdom and the US East Coast. tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what GTA 6 costs in a country. Returns the Standard and Ultimate edition price with how firm the figure is (confirmed from the official store listing, reported, estimate, billed in US dollars, or no price because the local store does not list it or there is no local store)

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Use this when someone asks which countries GTA 6 prices are tracked for, or which prices are confirmed. Lists every tracked market (101 today) with the price status of each; prices were last fully rechecked on November 4, 2026. Optional filter by status.

tools.name: get_latest_news
tools.description: Use this when someone asks for the latest GTA 6 news. Returns the newest published GTA6 Times stories, each with its label (Confirmed, Reported, Analysis or Guide), a one-line summary, the date and the URL, where the sources are listed.

tools.description: Use this when someone asks about the official GTA 6 trailers. Returns the videos released by Rockstar (Trailer 1, Trailer 2, An Extended Look, the Launch Trailer) with release dates, lengths where read from the official upload, and the page for each.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Use this when a search result needs its full text. Pass the id from the search tool (for example "answer:/gta-6/crossplay", "news:<slug>", "fact:<id>", "market:india", "trailer:<slug>"). Returns {id, title, text, url, metadata}, with the status and sources included in the text.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_latest_news, search, fetch · Private data: get_unlock_time, get_facts, check_claim · Public sink: get_trailers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_latest_news, search, fetch · Private data: get_unlock_time, get_facts, check_claim · Public sink: get_trailers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
